cases.decision: safe_extension_applied; shares_outstanding values that match a dollar-denominated share-capital column now abstain instead of persisting as share counts.

safe_extension.behavior: If the extracted shares_outstanding value matches a table cell from a dollar-denominated column, the extractor nulls shares_outstanding before the absolute-count bypass.

cases.decision: accept_as_ok_low_confidence_report_only; do not treat as strict-ok canonical truth and do not add a filter in this task. Filtering 1Q bank updates would be a policy decision broader than this source-bound audit.
